items.text: Approval artifact and action digest binding (canonical JSON, SHA-256)
Approval state machine with compare-and-set transitions in SQLite; single-use consumption
Approver authentication, eligibility and separation of duties; two-person quorum; escalation
Expiry, deny and timeout handling
Resume revalidation: identity, delegation, policy, resource state, approval validity, digest
Idempotency keys, execution records and reconciliation after a crash
Hash-chained audit and the 16-question reconstruction
The three approval protocols (arms A, B, C) and the policy-enforcing gateway they share
HTTP API and approval inbox (stdlib http.server), driven over real HTTP
Datadog (one event), Kubernetes, logging, tracing and ITSM (hitl/enterprise.py) with an effects ledger
The identity provider and identity context: principals, runtimes, the delegation, chat-user links (config/principals.yaml)
The Slack approval channel: messages and button clicks as function calls
Human waiting: the clock moves only when a scenario moves it
The agent: a deterministic evidence correlator and a fixed plan in place of a model
Actions changed after approval; replays; ineligible approvers; a guest click; an agent approving itself
World, identity and policy changes during the pause: hotfix, manual rollback, revoked delegation, disabled agent, policy v8, approver role removed
Duplicate clicks and webhooks, a worker crash after commit, two racing resume workers
Deny, silence, late approval, use after expiry; approval service and policy engine down; rollout failure; lost response
A durable workflow engine for long pauses (Temporal, Step Functions): the pause is a clock advance here
Out-of-band approver authentication (OIDC CIBA), step-up and signed approval records
Real Slack/Teams interactivity, a real IdP and a real cluster
Multi-agent approval chains and AI control plane integration
